newsitem.title: USA: Dow sees modest gains, Nasdaq slips.
newsitem.headline: Dow sees modest gains, Nasdaq slips.

text.p: U.S. blue chips saw modest gains in late morning trading on Wednesday, hovering around a 21-point increase at 7560.
The technology-laden Nasdaq composite slipped slightly lower, down about one point to 1400.
Analysts said the broader market was mixed as investors took profits and waited for economic data expected later this week.
The 30-year U.S. Treasuries was up 7/32 at a 6.82 percent yield. The Standard & Poor's futures index was off one at 867.70.
